text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To create a turning point in history. That's the goal Mejiro Ardan and I have set for senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tallying up everything I have to do as her trainer to make that happen is no simple feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a mountain of work to do today alone. And while I don't want to get stranded up that mountain, I can't afford to idle about at its base either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Mejiro Ardan is working extremely hard, making the most of every single second as she strives to reach our lofty goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I have to match that level of commitment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fully motivated, I take a seat at my desk!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hours fly by in a moment…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And I come to a realization just as the sun is starting to set.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's the fatigue from the past few days catching up with me, but I can barely keep my eyes open!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately… I don't have time… to rest…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling all right? You seem to have nodded off in your chair…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I glance out the window to find it's completely dark outside!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You've been hard at work all this time, yes? You have my appreciation.
choice_data_list: I was asleep when you found me, though…
I was asleep when you found me, though…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. And what a precious sight it was to see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Perhaps you'd consider turning in for today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: While you have displayed an extraordinary degree of motivation recently, you also appear to be overexerting yourself…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Compared to the effort Mejiro Ardan is putting in right now, there's no way the work I'm doing can be considered overexertion. I try to explain that to her but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, you're working far too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her expression is gentle, but the blunt truth in her words hits me like a truck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …In the time we've known one another, I've never before seen you so tired that you've fallen asleep at your desk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And for your nodding off to be so instantaneous that you didn't even realize it was happening… I simply cannot overlook this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you said that you would step in and stop me if I went too far. Do you not see a problem with yourself being in this state?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And with that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Judging by that reaction, I think it's safe to assume you were so focused on work that you forgot what day it is today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: These are for all you do on my behalf… Thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I made them myself, so you might notice some imperfections here and there, but I hope you'll enjoy them while you rest today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan's handmade chocolates are so beautiful they'd look at home on a department store shelf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I place one in my mouth. The gentle, snowy texture dances across my tongue as subtly sweet tones spread through my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …What do you think of the taste?
choice_data_list: It's so delicious… I feel so much warmth…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Goodness! It's truly an honor to hear that from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A cup of tea might go nicely with those. I'll just prepare you some. Please enjoy the chocolates while I get it ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bathed in the light of Mejiro Ardan's kindness, I swear on my heart that I'm going to stop pushing myself so hard—for her sake and mine…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trai… …ake… …ease.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Are you awake now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ceiling of my office and Mejiro Ardan peering at me—these are the first things my bleary eyes register.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You were sleeping face-down on your desk. Presumptuous as it may have been, I moved you into this position so you wouldn't wake up with muscle cramps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's when I come to the realization that my head is resting on Mejiro Ardan's lap.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Springing straight up like that is dangerous. Besides, you still appear quite exhausted, so I think you'd better rest a little more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As you've hardly had any time to unwind lately, perhaps you might like to relax a little more while you enjoy those chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There's plenty of space on my lap… should you need somewhere to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'll allow you to infer whether that was a serious offer or not, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Ardan's proposal takes me by surprise, it's one that clearly conveys her kindness…

text_block_list.text: I swear on my heart that I'm going to stop pushing myself so hard—for her sake and mine…
